body:
Raised: 2026-10-03 UTC. Moderator finding on PR #572, merge 239e5c53911091d02749dac2bb4033fe2a31ee35. Follow-up to #494; regional integration #489.

data/regional-review/regional-review-84c02938485232bd/reproduce-geometry.py:13 imports EPSG:4326 and immediately constructs a transformation to EPSG:6933, then passes ogr.CreateGeometryFromJson coordinates into it. GeoJSON coordinates are longitude, latitude. GDAL 3 defaults to authority-compliant EPSG:4326 axis order (latitude, longitude), as documented in https://gdal.org/en/stable/tutorials/osr_api_tut.html#crs-and-axis-order and OSGeo/gdal doc/source/tutorials/osr_api_tut.rst. The script never requests OAMS_TRADITIONAL_GIS_ORDER or an equivalent longitude-first CRS. It therefore measures Colombian geometry at the wrong latitude under normal GDAL 3 defaults.

This affects absolute areas and latitude-weighted relative area/symmetric-difference diagnostics for all 265 subjects and five department unions, not just a units label. Stored department source areas include Boyaca 6839.5156 km² and Santander 8852.302 km². A passing reproduction can reproduce the same coordinate-order mistake.

One bounded geography evidence correction. Coordinate with the original packet owner before reserving the directory. No changes to application geography, political records, IDs, certificates or live releases.

Acceptance:
- Explicitly configure GeoJSON longitude/latitude axis mapping before constructing transformations; record GDAL/PROJ versions and CRS policy.
- Validate against a known longitude/latitude point and an independent area reference or geodesic calculation, so a self-consistent wrong transform cannot pass.
- Recompute all affected audit.jsonl and department-union-comparison.json metrics, update README/proposals/classifications if conclusions change, and preserve superseded evidence provenance.
- Retain MakeValid as diagnostic clones only; do not mutate published source/current footprints.
- Keep source licenses, hashes, exact 265-unit scope and all historical records intact. Document unsupported topology/completeness rather than granting approval.

Validation limit: moderator inspected code, generated measurements and upstream GDAL documentation through connected GitHub; did not rerun GDAL or validate binary archive bytes.
